definitions.paired_delta: Candidate minus control for pairs 02-01 and 03-04. Rate percentages use the matching control as denominator. Time deltas are also in ms; acceptance deltas are percentage points.
definitions.within_arm_repeat_spread: Second occurrence minus first: 04-01 for control and 03-02 for candidate. Relative spread divides by the arithmetic mean of those two runs.
definitions.two_repeat_mean_comparison: Descriptive arithmetic mean of two candidate runs versus two control runs; not a confidence interval or significance test.
definitions.prefill_rate: prefill_tokps_per_request_mean is the arithmetic mean of per-request input_tokens/TTFT. The TTFT-derived wave value is a proxy, not throughput.
definitions.aggregate_rates: whole_run_* rates are summed tokens divided by summed timed-cell duration. decode_tokps_pooled_* is total output tokens divided by summed request decode windows; these differ from arithmetic means of per-request rates.
definitions.acceptance: Per-run and per-position rates use percentage-point deltas. The two-repeat weighted row is 100*sum(accepted_tokens)/sum(draft_tokens); the mean-comparison row is the arithmetic mean of run percentages.
definitions.inference_limit: Serving runs are the experimental units. Two repeats per variant yield only two paired contrasts and descriptive repeat spread; no request-level bootstrap or statistical confidence is computed.
